_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: softmax with home as the reference

agreement.claim: both engines report the same intercepts, log relative-risk ratios, standard errors and intervals
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: below 1e-6 on every key (1.1e-8 at 800 rows before the fixture was enlarged). harness/flexible_examples.test.py checks against a direct maximization of the multinomial likelihood and shows that with rehab as the reference the nursing coefficient becomes -1.47, a different comparison.

recovery.claim: each coefficient is close to the value the fixture was built with

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: At 800 rows with a nursing effect of -0.4, the nursing miss (0.61) exceeded the effect itself; the fixture uses 2000 rows and an effect of -0.8.
